issues.verification: Project-scoped encrypted secret CRUD returns metadata only. A live project-b v1 deployment returned HTTP 200, a revision-bound v2 HTTP 500 probe rolled back to v1, the post-rollback invocation returned v1, and Studio displayed revision, probe log, and restored digest without touching project-a.

issues.title: Configuration Ownership 能力缺失
issues.verification: Future Attach bindings seed read/update capabilities and five ownership domains. Both live projects return isolated ownership state, opaque CAS rejects a stale write with 409, desired/observed revisions and field owners are projected, and only Agent evidence with Applied=true advances observed state.

issues.verification: Fleet profile hides organization Usage and blocks the hosted usage API at the shared request boundary; cross-project usage aggregation remains a future Fleet capability.

issues.title: Cloud Billing/Marketplace/IPv4/Spend Cap UI 泄漏
issues.verification: The canonical Fleet capability matrix hides Billing, organization and project hosted integrations, compute pricing, Dedicated IPv4, Storage Analytics/Vectors entitlements, preview branching, ETL replication, and spend-cap upsells. Direct routes render an unavailable boundary.

issues.verification: Fleet capability defaults remove branching and ETL navigation, selectors, commands, dialogs, and mutations; direct pages show the unavailable boundary and the shared API guard rejects those routes.
